clue.text: Offence involving secret police chief resident in Russia

indicators.note: involving means the offence word wraps round the police chief

parts.note: an offence against morals is a sin
Lavrentiy Beria headed Stalin's NKVD secret police

explanation.surface: A Russian resident is caught up in a crime involving the head of the secret police.
explanation.walkthrough: Lavrentiy Beria ran Stalin's secret police; 'chief' here means the head man, not a first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A Siberian is a native or inhabitant of Siberia, the vast Asian region of Russia.

clue.text: Frame made from prime bit of soft wood

indicators.note: the prime bit of a word is its first letter, here taken from soft

parts.note: ash is a hardwood timber

explanation.surface: A window frame is made from the best part of some softwood.
explanation.definitionFit: A sash is the sliding frame holding the glass in a sash window.

clue.text: Composer's plight in country, stung when crossing river

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', linking the composer to his wordplay

indicators.note: in places the plight inside the name of the country

parts.note: Benin is a country in West Africa
being in a jam means being in a fix or plight

indicators.note: crossing means the stung word straddles the river letter

parts.note: bitten, as by an insect, means stung

explanation.surface: A composer is in a bad way abroad, stung by insects while fording a river.
explanation.walkthrough: BEN(JAM)IN, then B(R)ITTEN; 'when' just links the two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Britten was the English composer of Peter Grimes and the War Requiem.

clue.text: Turn up again after digesting a university course

indicators.note: digesting means the first word takes the following pieces inside it

parts.note: rear, like aft, describes the back or after part
PPE is Philosophy, Politics and Economics, an Oxford degree course

explanation.surface: Someone resurfaces after swallowing a university degree course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' looks like a positional link, but it is a synonym in its own right, the aft or back part.
explanation.definitionFit: To reappear is to come into view or turn up once more.

clue.text: Kingsley's out of order

parts.note: the novelist Kingsley ... possessive, written as one run, reads as a word for wrong

explanation.surface: The novelist Kingsley's behaviour is out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: Kingsley Amis was the English comic novelist of Lucky Jim; his possessive, run together, spells the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something amiss is wrong or faulty, just as something out of order is.

clue.text: They could be obtuse, though they founded Mercia

definitions.meaning: obtuse ... are those between 90 and 180 degrees
the Germanic people who settled England set up the Anglo-Saxon kingdom of Mercia

explanation.surface: Some people may be dim-witted, yet they established an ancient English kingdom.
explanation.walkthrough: Mercia was an Anglo-Saxon kingdom in the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Geometric figures may be obtuse, and the Germanic tribe founded Mercia; both share the name.

clue.text: Little kid that pinches things?

definitions.meaning: a small child is informally called a ...
something that nips, like a crab's claw, pinches

explanation.surface: A small child who steals.
explanation.definitionFit: Nipper is slang for a young child, and literally anything that nips or pinches.

clue.text: Which of two words has no E? It's not unimportant ultimately

definitions.text: Which of two words has no E?
definitions.meaning: of the pair least and last, the one lacking E is last, and it is not least
the phrase introduces a final item while insisting it matters

explanation.surface: A word puzzle about a missing letter, then a remark that it matters in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' is a link. The first reading is a riddle: compare LEAST and LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: The stock phrase is said when naming something last in a list that is still important.

clue.text: In festival, relaxed with pot — decline a lift

parts.note: to have sat back is to have relaxed
an urn is a large pot or vase

indicators.note: in a down clue lift means the words are raised, so read upwards

parts.note: to ail is to decline in health

explanation.surface: At a party someone relaxes with marijuana and turns down a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lift' turns AIL A into ALIA, read upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturnalia was the Roman winter festival of Saturn, now any wild revelry.

clue.text: Grouse, beef or carp?

definitions.meaning: to beef is slang for moaning
to carp is to find fault peevishly

explanation.surface: A list of a game bird, a meat and a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of the three verbs means to grumble or find fault, all the sense of moan.

clue.text: Italian enclave Romanians freely used

indicators.note: freely means the letters of Romanians are used in any order

explanation.surface: Romanians move without restriction in an Italian enclave.
explanation.definitionFit: San Marino is a tiny independent republic entirely surrounded by Italy.

clue.text: Put forward one employed in military establishment

indicators.note: employed in means placed to work within the following establishment

parts.note: a post is a military station or base
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone working at an army base proposes an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: To posit is to put forward a proposition as a basis for argument.

clue.text: Stingy type used to be prodigal at first

parts.note: was is the past of 'be'

indicators.note: at first takes the first letter of prodigal

explanation.surface: A miser who was once a spendthrift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stingy' looks like mean, but means having a sting.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasp is an insect with a sting, so playfully a stingy creature.

clue.text: Exercises inside appear to be right for some time

indicators.note: inside means the exercises go within the phrase for appear to be

parts.note: seem be stands for appear to be
PT is physical training

explanation.surface: Doing exercises looks proper at some point.
explanation.walkthrough: PT sits after the first two letters of SEEM BE, then R ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: September is a month, a stretch of time in the calendar.

clue.text: Unintelligent person standing by lift

parts.note: dumb is informal for stupid
a waiter stands by tables to serve

explanation.surface: A dim person waits next to an elevator.
explanation.walkthrough: A dumb waiter is a small lift carrying food between floors.
explanation.definitionFit: A small service elevator for food and dishes is called a dumb waiter.

clue.text: Varsity man subsequently held to be one-sided

indicators.note: held means the subsequent word is gripped between the other two pieces

parts.note: varsity is an old word for university, shortened to uni
Al is a man's name
later means subsequently

explanation.surface: A university man held that he was biased.
explanation.definitionFit: Unilateral describes action taken by one side alone.

clue.text: Marker a former pit employee positioned outside

indicators.note: the former pit worker is placed round the letter a

parts.note: ex means former
a miner works in a coal pit

explanation.surface: An ex-miner is now marking exam papers.
explanation.definitionFit: An examiner marks the papers set in an examination.

clue.text: Worker returning to European mountain

indicators.note: returning means the worker word comes back reversed

parts.note: the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: A worker heads home to a European peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning to' places the reversed ANT after E.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the active volcano in Sicily, a mountain.

clue.text: Plain: it's all wrong for climber

indicators.note: all wrong means the letters of plain and it's are jumbled

explanation.surface: A plain, flat landscape is quite wrong for a climber.
explanation.definitionFit: An alpinist is a mountaineer, especially in the Alps.

clue.text: Recent issue that's one's own responsibility

definitions.meaning: issue means offspring, so a newborn
a project or task one is responsible for

explanation.surface: A new problem that one must take charge of.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby is a newborn child, and figuratively a matter that is one's own concern.

clue.text: Woman left half of capital in Channel Islands, wanting Italian

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the Channel Islands abbreviation

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name

indicators.note: half of the capital keeps its first three letters

parts.note: London is the capital of the UK

explanation.surface: A woman left part of her capital in the Channel Islands, short of an Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' is a link here. LON is half of LONDON; the Channel Islands lie off Normandy.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannelloni is a stuffed tube pasta, an Italian dish.

clue.text: Time allowed for paying a southern state, in practice

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the practice word

parts.note: use means custom or practice
NC is North Carolina, a US southern state

explanation.surface: A deadline for a southern state to pay up, as is customary.
explanation.definitionFit: Usance is the period allowed for payment of a foreign bill of exchange.

clue.text: Servants are advancing with joints in centre of galley

indicators.note: the letter a moves forward in the servants word

parts.note: maids are servants
hips are joints

explanation.surface: Servants move ahead with joints in the middle of the ship's kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: Moving the A of MAIDS forward gives AMIDS. 'galley' is a ship, not a kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Amidships means in the middle of a ship, such as a galley.

clue.text: Hope to do away with a part of the church

indicators.note: do away with means remove the letter a

parts.note: to aspire is to hope

explanation.surface: Hopes to abolish a part of the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A spire is a tapering tower on a church.

clue.text: Unemployed maid left in the centre

indicators.note: in the centre means the letters are found in the middle of maid left

explanation.surface: A maid out of work is left at the centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle means not working or without a job.

clue.text: Authentic sound makes us sway

indicators.note: sound means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: real means authentic

explanation.surface: A genuine noise makes us rock.
explanation.definitionFit: To reel is to sway or stagger unsteadily.

clue.text: For example, Hyperion's image initially disowned by painter

indicators.note: the first letter of image is removed from the painter

parts.note: Titian was the Venetian Renaissance painter

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of image

explanation.surface: Hyperion's portrait was rejected by the artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Hyperion was one of the Titans, the giant deities of Greek myth.

clue.text: Get rid of bird in select group

indicators.note: in places the bird inside the select group

parts.note: an elite is a select group
mina is a variant of myna, the Asian starling

explanation.surface: Eject a bird from an exclusive club.
explanation.definitionFit: To eliminate is to remove or get rid of.

clue.text: One may do this to escape an old policeman

definitions.text: One may do this to escape
definitions.meaning: British slang for running off without paying
Bow Street ... were London's early police

explanation.surface: Fleeing from an elderly constable.
explanation.definitionFit: Do a runner means flee, and a Runner was an early London policeman.

clue.text: Like a Rechabite's drink, say — the whole lot!

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is'; Rechabites pledged total abstinence

indicators.note: say means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: tea is a drink
total means the whole lot

explanation.surface: A Rechabite's drink, and all of it.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rechabites were a temperance friendly society, so they shun alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: A teetotaller abstains from alcohol, as Rechabites vowed to.
